Title: Generally Available: Jumpstart Agora Contoso Hypermarket

Body.Content:
Jumpstart Agora Contoso Hypermarket has officially reached general availability, showcasing how Azure Arc and Azure AI services empower digital transformation in the retail industry.  This scenario brings next-gen innovations to life, such as AI-powered shopper analytics for real-time customer behavior insights, computer vision for enhanced store efficiency, and predictive inventory management with Microsoft Copilot. By simulating Contoso Hypermarket operations, users can explore cutting-edge solutions like natural language querying, edge-to-cloud data pipelines, and IoT-driven operational analytics, all designed to enhance customer experiences and streamline retail workflows.  Dive into this scenario today to discover how Azure technologies can transform retail operations and help businesses thrive in an evolving market.

Learn more.
